next.title: What happens after you write to us
steps: The export team reviews your requirements against the specification and current availability.
We contact you to confirm the details and any open points.
Prices, quantity, packing and terms are confirmed in writing for each order.
next.no_promise: Sending your requirements does not commit you or us to an order. Prices are confirmed per order.

privacy.title: How we use your details
